valores.label: Length of the Big Sur coast, per the 1986 plan ('over seventy miles')
Highway 1, San Luis Obispo county line to Carmel River (Caltrans post miles)
Census 1:500,000 coastline from Carmel-by-the-Sea to the county line (canal's check)

fonte: Monterey County, Big Sur Coast Land Use Plan (Local Coastal Program), 1986 (cópia do govinfo, CZIC)
legenda: The coast the 1986 plan covers, from Carmel to San Luis Obispo County.
texto_para_tela: MORE THAN 70 MI · MONTEREY COUNTY PLAN (1986)
credito_sugerido: Source: Monterey County, Big Sur Coast Land Use Plan, 1986
nota: P [51]. Duas conferências independentes: a Highway 1 da divisa de San Luis Obispo ao Carmel River mede PM 0.000 a 72.321 na lista da Caltrans, e a linha de costa do Census, de Carmel à divisa, 72.8 mi. As duas confirmam o 'over seventy miles'.

pedidos.pedido: P [51]: 'The Big Sur coast of Central California is over seventy miles in length and stretches from the Carmel area on the north, south to the San Luis Obispo County line' (R039). Tela MORE THAN 70 MI · MONTEREY COUNTY PLAN (1986).
